headlines.title: Claude Duet is here: Anthropic's 24/7 AI agent, tested
headlines.summary: Anthropic just launched Claude Duet, a 24/7 personal agent that works on its own computer in the cloud and comes to you with what needs your attention. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen tests it for 48 hours, compares it to Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots and Grok Bot, and breaks down the billions behind the AI agent race.

headlines.title: How Investors May Respond To Qualcomm Stock Earnings Outlook Concerns
headlines.summary: QUALCOMM affirmed a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.92 per share for December 2026 while reporting a 16.67% year on year decline in diluted EPS, a 20.00 P/E ratio and a 2.03% dividend yield, alongside weaker operating margins. The business is cutting its global workforce and facing pressure in smartphones and Apple related revenue, at the same time it commits capital to data center chips, robotics and AI partnerships with Amazon and Apple.

headlines.title: QUALCOMM’s Quarterly Earnings Preview: What You Need to Know
headlines.summary: QUALCOMM is expected to release its fiscal Q4 earnings early next month, while analysts project a significant EPS decline.

headlines.title: Qualcomm May Be Preparing Another Round of Job Cuts Next Month. Here’s What to Know.
headlines.summary: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon told employees the company is planning a global workforce reduction, with notifications expected to begin in November.

description: QUALCOMM Incorporated engages in the development and commercialization of foundational technologies for the wireless industry worldwide. It operates through three segments: Qualcomm CDMA Technologies (QCT); Qualcomm Technology Licensing (QTL); and Qualcomm Strategic Initiatives (QSI). The QCT segment develops and supplies integrated circuits and system software with connectivity and computing technologies for use in mobile devices; automotive systems for connectivity, digital cockpit, and ADAS/AD; and IoT, including consumer electronic devices, industrial devices, and edge networking products. The QTL segment grants licenses or provides rights to use portions of its intellectual property portfolio, which include various patent rights useful in the manufacture and sale of wireless products comprising products implementing LTE, and/or OFDMA-based 5G products and derivatives; to use cellular standard-essential patents, including 3G, 4G and 5G for cellular devices. The QSI segment invests in early-stage companies in various industries, including 5G, artificial intelligence, automotive, consumer, enterprise, cloud, IoT, and extended reality, and investments, including non-marketable equity securities and, to a lesser extent, marketable equity securities, and convertible debt instruments. It also provides development, and other services and sells related products to the United States government agencies and their contractors. In addition, the company is also involved in Qualcomm government technologies and data center businesses. Further, it provides security and intelligence services for unmanaged networks through software-based network security solutions. The company is in collaboration with Amazon to enable customized silicon at scale for large-scale AI data centers. QUALCOMM Incorporated was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
